title: 第3章 身残志坚第4章 这个杀手不太冷静
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
“吱扭！”房门被推开，晴儿端着一盆热水走进来。
月儿跟在后面，手里抱着一摞衣物。
晴儿放下水盆，走到床前，轻轻摇了摇黄夜。
“少爷，该起床了！”
黄夜很迷茫，自己是该起床还是不该呢，无从参考。
算了，稀里糊涂吧，迟早要变成正常人，先按自己理解的演，被发现也没办法。
现在那个月儿肯定是敌人，有没有其他敌人还不确定。
再次摇动的时候，黄夜迷迷蒙蒙睁开眼睛。
目光呆滞地看着两人。
“月儿，我怎么感觉少爷好像比以前严重了。”
“我觉得少爷挺正常。”
月儿不咸不淡地应道。
卧槽，好像演过头了，赶紧恢复一丝清明。
晴儿的小手已经掀开被角，黄夜下意识拽了一下被子。
这妞真大胆，她不怕自己什么都没穿么？
卧槽，她好像真不怕。
没办法，他只好松开手。
“少爷好像知道害羞了！”
卧槽，又演过了，真特么累。
“月儿，你把轮椅推过来。”

“嗯！”
看来原主真的是残疾，可怜而又可悲的人生。
这个该怎么演？算了，装作两腿无力吧。
晴儿上了床，温柔的小手拿着热毛巾，开始擦拭黄夜的脸。
接着是手，每一处擦得都很仔细。
别！里面就别擦了。
他想阻止，但怕被识破，只能忍着这种酸爽的感觉。
前胸，后背，……大腿，小腿，无一漏过。
“月儿，把内衣裤拿过来。”
想拒绝这种残暴的人身攻击方式，可是他不能。
如果只有晴儿一个人，他还能矜持一下，但有月儿在，只能忍。
两个丫头没有一丝害羞的样子，一切是那么平静自然，显然早已轻车熟路。
她们可以平静自然，黄夜不能，他已经清醒，会有自然反应。
肿么办，急中生智的黄夜想起一段台词，不断在心中叨咕。
南无阿弥陀佛，南无阿弥陀佛，南无阿弥陀佛……
别说，还真管用，心真的静下来了，直接变成躺尸。
任由两个丫头在他身上摆弄。
content_en:
"Squeak!" The door was pushed open, and Qing'er walked in with a basin of hot water.
Yue'er followed behind, holding a pile of clothes in her hands.
Qing'er put down the basin, walked to the bed, and gently shook Huang Ye.
"Master, it's time to get up!"
Huang Ye was very confused. She had no way of reference as to whether she should get up or not.
Forget it, just be confused, sooner or later you have to become a normal person, just act according to your own understanding, there is nothing you can do if you are discovered.
Now that Yue'er is definitely an enemy, it's not sure if there are other enemies.
When it shook again, Huang Ye opened his eyes in confusion.
He looked at the two of them with dull eyes.
"Yue'er, why do I feel that the young master seems to be more serious than before?"
"I think the young master is quite normal."
Yue'er replied in a neutral tone.
Damn it, it seems like you have overacted. Please regain some clarity quickly.
Qing'er's little hands had already lifted the corner of the quilt, and Huang Ye subconsciously tugged on the quilt.
This girl is so bold, isn't she afraid that she's not wearing anything?
Damn, she doesn't seem to be afraid.
He had no choice but to let go.
"The young master seems to know how to be shy!"
Damn it, I’ve done it again, it’s so tiring.
"Yueer, please push the wheelchair over."
"Yeah!"
It seems that the original owner is really disabled and has a pitiful and pathetic life.
How to act this? Forget it, just pretend that your legs are weak.
Qing'er got on the bed, holding a hot towel in her gentle hands, and began to wipe Huang Ye's face.
Then came the hands, wiping every place very carefully.
Don't! Don't rub it inside.
He wanted to stop it, but he was afraid of being discovered, so he could only endure the sour feeling.
The chest, the back,...the thighs, the calves, nothing was missed.
"Yue'er, bring me your underwear."
He wanted to refuse this brutal personal attack, but he couldn't.
If Qing'er was alone, he could still be reserved, but with Yue'er around, he could only endure it.
The two girls didn't look shy at all, everything was so calm and natural, and they were obviously familiar with the situation.
They could be calm and natural, but Huang Ye couldn't. He was already awake and would react naturally.
What should I do? Huang Ye, who was in a hurry, remembered a line and kept mumbling in his heart.
Namo Amitabha, Namo Amitabha, Namo Amitabha...
Don't tell me, it really worked. My mind really calmed down and I turned into a corpse.
Let the two girls play around with him.
